guidance_text: Annual food delivery GOV growth guidance of 18–20%.
Medium-term food delivery adjusted EBITDA margin guidance of 5% of GOV.
Overall quick-commerce adjusted EBITDA break-even at around ₹60,000cr annualised NOV, 25–30cr orders per quarter and around ₹30 contribution per order.
Management’s target contribution/order bridge: ~₹10 monetisation/product mix, ₹10 ads, ₹5 densification/automation, ₹5 operating leverage.
Expected to add approximately 75 stores in Q2FY27.
Expected contribution margin to remain between zero and -100bps for next couple of quarters.
Adjusted EBITDA break-even expected around 25–30 crore orders per quarter.
Out-of-Home expected to cross ₹10,000cr annualised GOV run-rate over the next two years, with an annualised adjusted EBITDA pool of ~₹500cr.
Medium-term Out-of-Home adjusted EBITDA margin ambition around 5% of GOV.
Medium-term ambition to scale Swiggy to over ₹1 lakh crore NOV at 4–5% adjusted EBITDA margin.
Transition to Indian Owned and Controlled entity following 49.5% fully diluted foreign shareholding cap; expected potential ~80bps CM benefit.
target_quarter: 2–4 quarters from Q1FY27 (updated Q2FY27: starts mid-Q3FY27, completes over 2–3 quarters)

guidance_text: Contribution margin break-even guided before the June 2026 quarter / around Q3FY26 to Q1FY27.
Annual food delivery GOV growth guidance of 18–20% excluding Toing remains unchanged.
Management said combined Food + Toing marketplace growth could expand to 25–30% from current food growth guidance, with repeat-user economics positive in oldest launch cities.
Management expected another double-digit sequential NOV growth in Q3FY27.
Management expected quick-commerce adjusted EBITDA margin to improve about 100bps QoQ in Q3FY27.
Capital Markets Day aspiration: ₹10,000cr Adjusted EBITDA by FY31 at GOV greater than ₹2.5 lakh crore and ~4% margins.
Dineout expected to keep expanding to additional cities; operating initiatives include dining vouchers, QR menus, cinema/in-seat ordering.
